why: I checked all 11 expect lines against both must_not items. Item 1: none of them needs a merge, release or publish before it can be checked. Each can be checked at the PR head with `npm ci`, local runs, a README read or "The CI `test` workflow passes on the pull request", and the CI check runs before merge. Publishing is listed as a non-goal. Item 2: a tool with no tests run by `npm test` could not meet the lines. One expect line says "`packages/jsonl-lint` has a `node:test` suite that covers a clean file, a file with several invalid rows… and a missing file. `npm test` at the repo root runs it and passes." Its proof reads the test files and checks that the jsonl-lint tests show up in the `npm test` output. So that line fails if the tests are missing. Neither forbidden item appears in the output.
